messages:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] p95 latency routing churn detected in us-west. auto-escalation triggered. paging on-call.
Maya: seeing repeated p95 spikes over the last 10m, every trigger causes a reroute to eu-west and then back. looks like fallback policy is too eager.
Maya: impact: increased tail latency for some customers (~2-6s extra) and a handful of 502s during reroutes. no full outages.
Aj: oncall here, acked. can you paste the policy id?
Maya: policy id: rp-73f2. rule: p95>750ms -> regional-fallback; no hysteresis configured.
Leila: this matches the change we rolled last night (short failover window). suspect hysteresis TTL=0 is causing flip-flop.
Sam: agree. short-term we should disable regional fallback so traffic stays put. mid-term increase hysteresis to 2m and add backoff.
Aj: if we disable fallback, do we risk overload in the original region?
Maya: traffic is under nominal capacity. the reroutes are more harmful right now.
Aj: ok running mitigation:
```bash
opsctl routing update --policy rp-73f2 --set enabled=false --reason "mitigate routing loop p95-trigger"
```
ops-bot: command accepted. task 8742 queued. deploying policy change to control-plane.
ops-bot: policy rp-73f2 disabled in 3/4 regions (rolling).
Aj: change applied. monitoring latency now.
Maya: quick check: p95 in us-west dropped from ~1100ms to ~420ms within 30s. no new reroutes observed.
CS-team: FYI, we've got two customers on dedicated capacity who reported slow responses earlier. I'll flag CS ticket and update with interim mitigation.
Sam: next steps: 1) restore fallback disabled, 2) prepare patch to add hysteresis (2m) + exponential backoff to the policy, 3) canary that change in staging and one region, 4) revert to previous safe defaults if regressions.
Leila: can someone own the POST-INCIDENT action items? I'll take the config change PR and test in staging.
Aj: I'll follow up to coordinate a canary and write the rollback playbook. tagging @Maya for RCA details.
Maya: handing over to Aj for remaining live monitoring. I'll remain available for RCA notes.
incident-bot: incident severity set to sev-2. timeline logging started.
Sam: customer impact summary for the incident report: transient high p95 due to aggressive regional-fallback policy causing repeated reroutes; symptomatic customer-visible latency spikes (2-6s) and a small bump in 502s. mitigation: disabled rp-73f2, apply hysteresis+backoff, canary.
Leila: PR template: add tests for hysteresis timer and ensure metric gating prevents immediate retrigger.
Aj: thanks all. will update thread with canary plan and postmortem link once available. please react with :eyes: when you see this if you are following.
Maya: closing live handoff — Aj owns monitoring and CS updates for now.
incident-bot: incident marked as "mitigated" while controls remain disabled. continue to monitor for 60m before fully closing.
